post.title: Vendor names match but VLOOKUP still returns #N/A
post.description:
vlookup na error even though vendor names match and trim doesn't help
Names copied out of a web portal carry a non-breaking space, character 160, which TRIM leaves alone. Swap it out with SUBSTITUTE and the match comes back. Save this one for close.
